rules.rule: Prioritize exploitable workflow defects. Check least-privilege permissions, full-length immutable action pins, untrusted pull request input, secret exposure, dependency installation, artifact retention, concurrency, and timeouts. With pull_request_target, pull request code must be treated only as data and must never be checked out and executed.

Check contradictions with canonical configuration, invalid commands or paths, unverifiable completion claims, leaked secrets or personal data, unsafe setup guidance, and missing migration or rollback instructions. Prefer actionable correctness findings over wording or style suggestions.

Prioritize concrete correctness, security, data-loss, concurrency, resource-leak, backward-compatibility, and regression risks. Check whether tests cover observable behavior and failure paths. Do not report formatting or subjective style unless it hides a defect. State the triggering input, impact, and smallest useful verification for every finding; omit speculative findings that cannot be tied to changed code. Review the code by risk regardless of the author's seniority. Explain the technical reason without ranking or judging the author.
